title: 第6章 嫁妆188万
slug: 狗哥你再舔女主我就和黄毛私奔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

踏进门槛的第一秒，就有啜泣声传来。

赵楹月当即警铃大作。

“大小姐，你终于回来了……”

管家一看见赵楹月，就立刻激动的迎了上来。

可还不等他把话说完，赵楹月便皱眉不悦问：“许叔，谁在里面哭？”

管家犹犹豫豫，最终硬着头皮回答：“是孟小姐。”

孟以棠？

那个把她哥当成舔狗冤大头的小说女主？

‘腾’的一下，赵楹月撩起袖子，气势汹汹的闯了进去。

客厅里。

一个穿着白色连衣长裙的女人坐在沙发上，哭的我见犹怜。

一头乌黑秀丽的长发自然的散在身后，细腰盈盈一握，露出的那张小脸清秀倔强，却挂满泪痕。

“随野，我真的不知道该怎么办了……妈妈她手术需要用钱，我好不容易凑够，那天却全部赔了出去，工作也丢了……”

说到最后，话音全被悲伤的抽泣声盖住。

赵随野满眼心疼。

伸手想要拍拍她的后背，可转念又想起自己什么身份都不是，便收了回来。

递过去一张干净的纸张，安慰她：“棠棠，你别哭，阿姨的医药费我帮你出。”

“不行，”孟以棠抬起那双水润的眼眸，摇头，“我妈妈从小教育我，不能白拿别人的钱，随野，你的心意我收到了。”

那句‘别人’，将赵随野的心狠狠刺痛了一瞬。

闷的像浸了水的棉花。

唇边的笑容都变得有几分牵强起来。

“棠棠，阿姨在我们赵家也待了几十年，我和你从小一起长大。”

“就当我借给你的好不好？先给阿姨治病重要——”

“哥！”

突然横插进来的声音，令赵随野的话戛然而止。

他和孟以棠下意识的朝着玄关看去。

一个染着彩虹头的女生，风风火火的大步走来。

赵楹月停在离他们两米远的地方。

看看愣神忘了哭泣的孟以棠，又看看太阳穴跳的像机关枪的赵随野。

忽然就改变了主意。

眼珠子滴溜溜的转了一圈，然后露出一个讨好的笑容。

“哥，你也借我一点钱呗！”

赵楹月从回到赵家后，不上学也不上班。

问就是早就博士毕业了。

至于上班？

Page (1/3)

The first second I stepped into the threshold, I heard sobs.

Zhao Yingyue immediately raised the alarm.

"Miss, you are finally back..."

As soon as the housekeeper saw Zhao Yingyue, he immediately came over excitedly.

But before he could finish speaking, Zhao Yingyue frowned and asked, "Uncle Xu, who is crying in there?"

The housekeeper hesitated and finally answered bravely: "It's Miss Meng."

Meng Yitang?

The heroine in the novel who treats her brother as a scapegoat?

With a 'thump', Zhao Yingyue rolled up her sleeves and rushed in aggressively.

in the living room.

A woman wearing a long white dress was sitting on the sofa, crying so hard that I felt pity for her.

Her long, beautiful black hair naturally spreads out behind her, and her slender waist is tightly grasped. The exposed little face is delicate and stubborn, but covered with tears.

"Sui Ye, I really don't know what to do... Mom needs money for her surgery. I finally managed to get enough money, but I lost it all that day and lost my job..."

At the end of the sentence, the words were completely covered by sad sobs.

Zhao Suiye's eyes were filled with distress.

He reached out and wanted to pat her back, but then he remembered that he had no identity, so he took it back.

He handed her a clean piece of paper and comforted her: "Tangtang, don't cry. I will help you pay for your aunt's medical expenses."

"No," Meng Yitang raised his moist eyes and shook his head, "My mother has taught me since I was a child that you can't take other people's money for nothing. Sui Ye, I accept your wishes."

That phrase "someone else" stung Zhao Suiye's heart for a moment.

As stuffy as cotton soaked in water.

The smile on his lips became a bit forced.

"Tangtang, aunt has been in our Zhao family for decades. You and I grew up together."

"Just think of it as something I lent to you? It's important to treat your aunt first—"

"Brother!"

The sudden intrusion of a voice brought Zhao Suiye's words to an abrupt end.

He and Meng Yitang subconsciously looked towards the entrance.

A girl with rainbow hair strode forward in a hurry.

Zhao Yingyue stopped two meters away from them.

Look at Meng Yitang who was so stunned that he forgot to cry, and then look at Zhao Suiye whose temples were beating like machine guns.

Suddenly he changed his mind.

His eyes rolled around, then he gave a flattering smile.

"Brother, you can also lend me some money!"

After Zhao Yingyue returned to Zhao's house, she neither went to school nor went to work.

The question is, I have already graduated with a Ph.D.

As for going to work?
